• Working diagnosis (per transcript): Recurrent Transient Ischemic Attacks (TIAs) – high clinical concern given unilateral deficits and positive family history of carotid disease.  
• Differential diagnoses from DDx considered but not discussed in transcript include multiple sclerosis and others; not incorporated into current management (conflict noted – see Quality checks).  
Plan:  
1. Urgent referral to hospital TIA / stroke clinic (expected review within 1–2 days).  
2. Provide patient with clinic and PALS contact numbers to confirm appointment.  
3. Education: If future episode is prolonged or persistent, attend Emergency Department immediately.  
4. Advise to re-contact GP if any delays or further concerns.  
5. Review need for ongoing aspirin therapy after specialist input; risks/benefits to be discussed once diagnosis clarified.
